name: app-spiritual-journey-music-player-geometric-teal-purple-pattern
title: Music player app with a geometric teal-purple triangle pattern behind the album art and track list
whatItIs: Three phone screens for a music app: a 'Now Playing' screen with a circular album art disc over a triangle-and-circle geometric pattern, a track list ('Anchor', 'State Lines'...) with heart icons on the same pattern, and an 'Other Albums' grid on a plain white background.
whatItMeans: Rhythmic and stylish; the geometric pattern behind the player controls gives the interface a strong, memorable visual identity beyond typical album art.
techniques: Use a bold geometric pattern as a persistent UI background.
Keep the pattern only on player screens, switching to plain white for browsing.
Render the album art as a circular disc echoing a vinyl record.

vocabulary.definition: A pattern or colour kept consistent across a set of screens.
A circular shape referencing a vinyl or CD.
